meta.name: team-communication-protocols
meta.description: Structured messaging protocols for agent team communication including message type selection, plan approval, shutdown procedures, and anti-patterns to avoid. Use this skill when establishing communication norms for a newly spawned team, when deciding whether to send a direct message or a broadcast, when a team-lead needs to review and approve an implementer's plan before work begins, when orchestrating a graceful team shutdown after all tasks are complete, or when debugging why teammates are not coordinating correctly at integration points.

copy.tagline: 规范智能体团队的沟通与协作流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发多智能体系统,需要统一团队通信规则
copy.fit_line_en: For you if building multi-agent systems and need clear messaging protocols.

howto.what: Claude 在 agent 团队协作时按固定协议沟通:选择私信、广播或关闭请求等消息类型,处理计划审批,优雅关闭团队,并按队友名字发消息和派活。
howto.when: 新建团队要定沟通规范、纠结该用私信还是广播、或 team-lead 要先审批实施者的计划时触发。

say.text: 帮我给这个新团队定一套沟通规范,说清消息类型怎么选。
say.note: 会给出消息类型选择与要避开的反模式

say.text: implementer-1 交上来的计划帮我审一下,不行就写修改意见。
任务都完成后,帮我优雅关闭整个团队。
say.note: 逐个发 shutdown_request 后再清理团队资源

howto.what_en: Claude follows a fixed messaging protocol when coordinating an agent team: it picks direct messages, broadcasts, or shutdown requests, handles plan approval, shuts teams down gracefully, and addresses teammates by name.
howto.when_en: Triggers when setting communication norms for a new team, deciding between a direct message and a broadcast, or when a lead must approve an implementer's plan before work starts.

say_en.text: Help me set communication norms for this new team, including message types.
Review implementer-1's plan and tell them what to change.
Once all tasks are done, shut the team down gracefully.
say_en.note: Sends shutdown_request, then deletes team resources
